readerCopy.body: A threat loses power once the consequence behind it is no longer enough to force compliance. When Pluto opposes Lilith, concentrated leverage faces refusal directly through money, access, secrets, status, approval, or fear on one side and a decision to stop paying that price on the other. The balance can shift quickly after the threat stops working. The strongest use of the change is protecting what matters and reducing the old source of control, not proving that domination can now run in the opposite direction.
